relationships.source_case_title: Vishaka v. State of Rajasthan (AIR 1997 SC 3011)

relationships.source_case_title: Mohd. Ahmed Khan v. Shah Bano Begum (AIR 1985 SC 945)
relationships.target_statute: Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Divorce) Act, 1986
relationships.primary_evidence_document: Statement of Objects and Reasons, Act No. 25 of 1986; Lok Sabha Debates Feb-May 1986
relationships.exact_anchor: Statement of Objects and Reasons, Gazette of India Extraordinary
relationships.notes: Enacted to supersede the immediate effect of Shah Bano regarding Section 125 CrPC; subsequently harmonized in Danial Latifi (2001).

relationships.source_case_title: D.K. Basu v. State of West Bengal (AIR 1997 SC 610)

relationships.source_case_title: Justice K.S. Puttaswamy (Retd.) v. Union of India ((2017) 10 SCC 1)
relationships.target_statute: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (Act 22 of 2023)

relationships.exact_anchor: Statement of Objects and Reasons, Paragraph 2
relationships.notes: Puttaswamy privacy mandate led to the formal formulation and parliamentary enactment of DPDP Act 2023.

relationships.source_case_title: Shayara Bano v. Union of India ((2017) 9 SCC 1)
